idea-plugin.name: Jira Issue Tracker
idea-plugin.description:
🚀 Jira Issue Tracker

Streamline your workflow by managing Jira issues directly within your development environment. This high-performance, feature-rich plugin is designed for developers who want to minimize context switching.

✨ Key Features

  • Interactive Board: A native Agile board with status columns and real-time synchronization.
  • Drag-and-Drop: Move issue cards between columns to instantly transition Jira statuses.
  • Detailed Dialog: Access descriptions, status, and metadata in a professional detail dialog.
  • Responsive UI: Toolbar buttons automatically adapt to the panel width for optimal workspace usage.
  • Smart Browsing: Search and filter issues using custom JQL queries.
  • Session Persistence: Automatically restores your last selected project and waits for IDE indexing.

🚀 Getting Started

Configure your connection in Settings → Tools → Jira Issue Tracker by providing your Jira URL, Email, and API Token.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.2.0
    • Introduced Interactive Agile Board with drag-and-drop status transitions.
    • New professional Issue Detail Dialog accessible via double-click.
    • Responsive toolbar that hides buttons in narrow views to save space.
    • Improved indexing support (waits for IDE to finish indexing before refreshing).
    • Premium UI aesthetics with theme-aware cards and metadata badges.
  • 1.1.1
    • Added option to associate existing issues with sprints directly from the details panel.
    • Implemented double-click to toggle (show/hide) the issue details panel.
    • Added persistence for the last selected space/project across IDE restarts.
    • UI refinements and improved detail panel layout.
